## File: vllm-project_vllm/vllm/device_allocator/cumem.py

Prompts

```
['create a CuMemAllocator singleton instance to manage CUDA memory pool with sleep mode support', 'use CuMemAllocator to put allocator in sleep mode and offload tagged tensors to CPU memory', 'use CuMemAllocator to wake up from sleep mode and restore offloaded tensors back to GPU memory', 'use CuMemAllocator context manager to allocate tensors in a tagged memory pool', 'use use_memory_pool_with_allocator context manager to get a memory pool and pluggable allocator']
```

